actor: Export administration policy officer, Bureau of Industry and Security End-User Review Committee
job: Working the pending entity package on ChangXin, weighing the supply-impact record against the case for adding the company.
outcome: No interagency decision that sends a ChangXin addition to the Federal Register for publication.
motivation: The committee is asked to use an equipment control against a company whose output American brands now need.

task.who: BIS export administration staff supporting the review committee
task.what: Reassess the pending ChangXin entity package
task.why: The instrument constrains buying, not the selling complained about
task.how: Supply-impact memo circulated with the package

actor: China trade negotiations lead, Office of the United States Trade Representative
job: Running the negotiating rounds whose continuation is the stated reason the ChangXin listing recommendation was paused in June.
outcome: A trade track live enough that new Entity List additions stay off the table.
motivation: A listing announced mid-round costs the negotiation more than it gains on the export-control file.

task.who: USTR China office with Commerce and Treasury counterparts
task.what: Schedule the next negotiating round with Beijing
task.where: Bilateral trade talks and truce extension terms
task.why: The pause was tied to the talks continuing
task.how: Truce extension terms agreed before the current expiry

actor: Memory commodity manager, HP notebook supply chain
job: Allocating qualified ChangXin DRAM into budget notebooks for non-US markets while holding Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron elsewhere.
outcome: Two live bills of materials, split by destination, that a listing would force HP to rebuild.
motivation: There is not enough non-Chinese memory to build every machine the notebook line has to ship.

task.who: HP commodity purchasing and regional build planning teams
task.what: Allocate ChangXin volume by destination market
task.where: Notebook bill of materials and build plans
task.why: Non-Chinese memory cannot cover the whole build
task.how: Destination-coded sourcing rules in the planning system

actor: Trade compliance counsel, Asus global supply chain
job: Writing and enforcing the destination rule that keeps ChangXin parts out of United States shipments absent any law requiring it.
outcome: A documented internal restriction, not a legal one, that keeps the split defensible if Washington asks.
motivation: The company is drawing a line it expects rather than one it has been given.

task.who: Asus legal and trade compliance function
task.what: Document the destination restriction on ChangXin parts
task.where: Supplier approval records and shipment screening rules
task.why: No published rule defines the line yet
task.how: Supplier approval matrix keyed to ship-to country

actor: Government affairs director, semiconductor industry trade association
job: Filing the supply-impact case with Commerce so the cost of listing a working DRAM supplier sits on the record.
outcome: Comments and briefings that put notebook build risk into the Entity List decision file.
motivation: Members cannot price devices if a memory source disappears from the approved list mid-shortage.

task.who: Association policy staff and member company representatives
task.where: BIS rulemaking dockets and agency briefings
task.why: The shortage cost must reach the decision record
task.how: Member-sourced shortage data filed under the docket

actor: Legislative counsel for export controls, House select committee on China staff
job: Drafting the covered-semiconductor purchasing and tariff language the committee letters have started pointing at instead of an Entity List addition.
outcome: A purchasing or tariff instrument moving through Congress rather than a Federal Register Entity List amendment.
motivation: The Entity List cannot stop an American brand buying Chinese memory; a purchasing rule can.

task.who: Committee counsel with the legislative drafting service
task.where: Authorisation bill amendments and committee letters
task.why: The Entity List reaches suppliers, not buyers
task.how: Existing covered-semiconductor procurement statute as template

actor: Acquisition policy analyst, federal procurement rule-writing council
job: Turning the covered Chinese semiconductor prohibition into contract clauses that reach federal buyers rather than retail notebooks.
outcome: A procurement rule that answers the security grievance without amending the Entity List.
motivation: Federal purchasing is the reach the Pentagon listing already has, and the one agencies can enforce.

task.who: Civilian and defence acquisition regulation drafting staff
task.why: Procurement reaches government buyers the list cannot

actor: Capacity planning lead, ChangXin Memory Technologies DRAM operations
job: Converting the Shanghai listing proceeds into output volume steady enough for Western notebook programmes to keep scheduling around it.
outcome: Sustained qualified supply that makes removing ChangXin from Western bills of materials expensive.
motivation: Design wins only hold if the volume arrives every quarter the notebook programmes plan for.

task.who: ChangXin operations and customer programme management
task.what: Commit quarterly DRAM volume to notebook customers
task.where: Fab output planning and customer supply agreements
task.why: Qualified volume is what makes the split costly
task.how: Multi-quarter supply agreements with module buyers

actor: Component qualification engineering lead, Acer notebook platform team
job: Extending qualification of ChangXin parts across more budget platforms so the non-US bill of materials stops depending on one model.
outcome: ChangXin DRAM qualified into enough platforms that the sourcing decision is structural rather than a trial.
motivation: A supplier still being evaluated is easy to drop; one qualified across platforms is not.

task.who: Acer platform validation and component engineering
task.what: Qualify ChangXin modules on additional platforms
task.where: Platform validation labs and approved vendor list
task.why: One-model sourcing is reversible; platform-wide sourcing is not
task.how: Standard memory qualification and compatibility test suite
